description: This file defines the Stream class implementing the StreamInterface, providing methods to read, write, seek, and manipulate PHP streams. It encapsulates typical stream operations such as serialization, metadata access, and resource management.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A class implementing StreamInterface that wraps a PHP stream resource providing common stream operations such as reading, writing, seeking, and getting metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Stream object with a PHP stream resource.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Reads the entire stream content as a string, seeking to the beginning beforehand.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the resource from the stream object, rendering it unusable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream resource is seekable.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata, or a specific key if provided.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached the end.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Seeks to the beginning of the stream.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, returns number of bytes written.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable based on its mode.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads up to specified bytes from the stream.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable based on its mode.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads remaining content from the stream.
